title: VeloraOS 1.10.27 - Hardware-Aware Coding
releaseNotes: Adds a separate VeloraOS Coding option to Chat.
VeloraOS Coding automatically selects the strongest installed programming model suitable for the detected RAM and acceleration capability.
Adds coding tiers from Qwen2.5-Coder 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B and 14B through Qwen3-Coder 30B on high-memory accelerated systems.
Marks the recommended coding model for the current machine on the Models page.
Keeps Coding usable through a specialist fallback profile when the recommended dedicated coder has not yet been installed.
Coding mode uses a dedicated software-engineering instruction profile focused on runnable code, debugging correctness, secure defaults and minimal regressions.
Automatic web research and Lockdown mode remain available with the Coding profile.
